scope: Entire tools redesign and all affected v4 data/execution/solver/application/example/test/help/build consumers; legacy and v1-v3 excluded.
sourceAPI: Value Config; value observations/styles/datasets; tools.analyze.Timer and Visualizer resource owners; data-owned external plot methods; no old tools proxy classes.
compatibility: Valid numericRecord/runRecord v1 remain supported; execution reads checkpoint envelopes v1/v2 and projects saved model identities. Source APIs intentionally change in major version 2.0.0.

repairs.behavior: All-element field/function predicates, scalar native assertion conditions, explicit complete error identifiers and full checked factor counts.
Transactional value updates, pure restricted parser, owner validators, static non-owning predicates and frozen numeric input bindings; observation and derived workspace are separate.
Single active timing token with failure cancellation and value snapshots, opt-in diagnostic matrix hashing, bounded explicit environment metadata.
Strict flags, exact numeric/string/sparse/complex shapes, resource budgets and MAT commit inventory; State and checkpoint responsibilities separated, automatic accepted-step identities unique.
Common FEM owns physical/nested sampling; pure weighted reductions keep spatial/component/sequence norms distinct; plasma owns physical F with independent velocity bases and nonconstant AP scale.

Empty component selections do not solve; owner-adapted references determine actual levels; scoped Analysis timing restored. All-mode identity stays stable across growing velocity spaces; resolved IDs remain explicit, long/colliding table keys preserve full identities. Component selectors reject text arrays, implicit character-code conversion, complex IDs and nonvector arrays before indexing.

Graph methods move to data; plain typed views preserve original component IDs and paired x/v geometry. Visualizer alone owns graphics resources, layouts, rollback and veto/reset; time interpolation uses paired accepted frames.
Every retained study uses new observation/style/configuration APIs without weakening scientific test equations or tolerances; numerical problem/solve entrypoints remain observer-free.

resolved: Normal MATLAB EOF was distinguished from read failure.
Vector assertion conditions were explicitly reduced before native assert.
Nested steady Assembly and controller timing intervals were separated.
Steady smoke studies no longer receive time-only keys; kinetic studies get bounded time horizons.
AP Psi/Q and Hermite P/E identities remain distinct.
Benchmark cell payloads are explicitly wrapped as one record value.
Native console logs use raw file capture rather than assuming their encoding.
Cached MATLAB class dependency paths are mapped only for SHA-256-identical members of the explicit staged payload; other external/changed dependencies remain errors.
nonblockingEnvironmentWarnings: Windows/WSL UNC change-notification and project-opening warnings remain environment-specific observations; the native-drive copied project, source suites and fresh installation passed. Exact warning cause is not established.

evidenceBoundary: Native Windows MATLAB R2025b. Passing checks cover the declared numerical regimes and fixtures; they do not prove arbitrary-parameter stability, full-line physical-F quadrature exactness, or other platforms. Historical design probes and v4 acceptance are preserved separately.

artifactIntegrity.method: Read every manifest payload from fsroot in the actual .mltbx ZIP and compare exact bytes with its explicit current source; compare generated manifest structurally.

sourceControlPreparation.reason: Preserve exact upstream DistMesh CRLF bytes in Git and deterministic LF for project text.
